text_block_list.text:
One day, Matikanefukukitaru found herself 
faced with a difficult dilemma.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh... Is there really no way... we can 
call off studying for the test?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, of course. Yep. Just thought 
I'd say it. Yep."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It can't be helped. Just for 
once, I'll get serious— or rather, let out 
my divine aura!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Nghhh... Nguuuuoooooohh---!!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
How do you like this divine aura?! With 
such immense power, even the cherry 
blossoms are in full bl—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, WHAAAAAT!?!? Why cherry blossoms!? 
Where is my Trainer!?
—Welcome, Fukukitaru—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Wait, me?! What—?! Could it be a 
doppelgänger?!

text_block_list.name: Lady Shiraoki?
text_block_list.text:
—I am Shiraoki. I have manifested by 
borrowing your body—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Lady Shiraoki!? Um, what on earth does 
this mean...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hae?! Where are you going?! W-Wait for 
meee!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... W-Why all of a sudden... did 
I end up running with Lady Shiraoki?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... as expected of Lady Shiraoki, so 
fast! And, what is this feeling...?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: —My body feels so light...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Phew... To think I could run alongside 
Lady Shiraoki. It feels like a dream!

text_block_list.name: Lady Shiraoki?
text_block_list.text:
—Fufu. Even when you wake up, please don't 
forget how this feels...—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
............ Trainer... I think I've 
awakened.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
No! Not that! It's more like awakening to 
a new power!

I didn't quite understand what happened, 
but from that day on, Matikanefukukitaru's 
running was sharper than ever!
